correctness.rationale: For the exact four-compartment Mohamed (2026) ODE and all fourteen positive parameters b=28, d=h1=h2=h3=k1=k2=r1=r2=1, sigma1=10, sigma2=5/2, alpha1=1577/4000, alpha2=alpha3=1/1000, direct substitution gives R0=102067/117000<1, E0=(28,0,0,0) and E1=(20,1,1/4,11/2). Reconstruct C=z>0: S=z(9+4z)/(2(1+z)), D=10S/(1+S)+5z/(2(1+z)), U=28/(1+L). H(z)=-z(4z-1)Q(z)/P(z), P>0, with Q sextic whose coefficient sequence has one sign change and Q(1/4)=-561250<0<Q(1/2)=10802295/8. Descartes and IVT imply exactly one additional simple positive root, hence exactly two positive equilibria and just E0 on the boundary. Independent SymPy rational substitution/reduction verifies H and both 4x4 characteristic polynomials; Routh-Hurwitz at E0 and the sign-changing cubic at E1 prove local stability/instability. Implicit-function/simple-root arguments make multiplicity robust, not two stable attractors. Finite arithmetic is corroborative; the exact signs, Descartes and stability arguments prove the general stated assertions.
